gated.inherited: Every hx1 gate as in hair_stable/predicted.json part1_bundle: 0 strands->cards of any cause, 0 frames on cards, watchdog 0, header at the scene G-buffer pass only, rebase origin 0.
gated.worker: Every '[hair groom] <id> LOD n decoded (v3...' line inside the moving windows says ', worker' (event gate, no decode in the build), and the run has at least one worker decode (pre-in uploads the near LODs: 6-8 decodes in hx1 180928 and 190905).
gated.no_groom_dropped: '(groom dropped)' 0 in the '[hair groom] frame' line of every bundle window: a pending LOD keeps the built one (rt_hair_groom_lod_keep), it never falls back to cards on a LOD switch.

predicted_not_gated.kept_frames: 'waiting for upload N (kept)' 0-80 groom-frames per 180-frame dolly window (r4-inn ON 54-59 per 120 frames with 10-11 decodes; S8 has fewer grooms near the camera), 0 in the orbits once their LODs are resident.

predicted_not_gated.decodes: pre-in and pre-out hold most of them; 0-4 in each later bundle window (evictions).
predicted_not_gated.cost: Strand G-buffer GPU ms within hx1 202905's spread (no shader change).

decision: Confirm rt_hair_groom_async in the RTX Hair On bundle (applied overnight 2026-11-21 on claude/hair-async) if every inherited gate holds, no groom is dropped and the card-run median stays at most 6; otherwise revert it from the bundle and keep the key READY_FOR_LIVE.
